records.meaning: One immutable no-effect program binding exact active D65/D67 source sections, one ordered D65 product-construction stage vocabulary, and exact operational separation policies.

One closed immutable record binding the exact construction and attempt identities, program, Project, subject, permitted stages, locality, reversibility, and zero-effect ceiling; the attempt carries its repository-local ref and raw-byte digest.

One construction and attempt identity, exact authorization ref and digest, ordered product-construction stage observations, separately typed operational-support tasks, blocker list, routine-confirmation posture, and optional immutable packet reference.
One operational-support task with exact identity, state, owner, affected D65 stage or null, and typed basis declaring none, an exact prerequisite, or an applicable safety or authority boundary.
Every validated stage resolves one repository-contained artifact ref whose exact raw bytes match the stage digest.
When a stage requires and claims a bound owner gate, one closed immutable no-effect record must bind the exact attempt, stage, Project, subject, authorization digest, and scope.

One closed frozen test-input packet binding construction and attempt IDs, Project, subject, exact program and authorization, stage-set and complete attempt-basis digests, requested decision, final owner, procedure, residue, rollback, challenge route, and exact prior decisions; it carries no mutable outcome.
One immutable result record binding the exact frozen packet ref and raw-byte digest and recording passed or failed; it never replaces or mutates the packet exercised by the human.

One deterministic decision of CONTINUE, STOP, READY_FOR_HUMAN_TEST, or REQUEST_TERMINAL_CONFIRMATION with causal product-stage states, explicit blocking or deferred operational-task results, distinct blocker and authority requests, and no effect authority.

Every applicable stage requires all earlier applicable stages validated against exact repository bytes and any required owner gate; missing, stale, invalid, ambiguous, fabricated, or skipped predecessors fail closed and make downstream stages blocked or not_evaluable.

D65 stages are product-construction work; repository maintenance, environment, bookkeeping, migration administration, publication or deployment preparation, monitoring, and similar surrounding work are operational support.

Pending operational support blocks only when it names the exact current D65 frontier as a prerequisite or applicable safety, privacy, authority, destructive-action, credential, or external-effect boundary. Unrelated and future operations remain visible deferred residue while product construction continues.
Routine confirmation is false for all nonterminal decisions and true only when every applicable stage validates and an exact frozen passing human-test packet is current.
A terminal request cannot repair or approve earlier missing gates, stale bytes, invalid stages, or a changed packet.
Candidate exact binding from the generated continuous-construction system ontology to the Rust library and CLI under runtime/.

Preserve source identity, bounded authorization, ordered predecessor continuity, separate product and operational lanes, exact operational blocker scope, visible deferred operational residue, complete downstream classification, owner-gate separation, packet immutability, terminal-only confirmation, deterministic output, and zero authority/effect.

residue.meaning: This Product Capability remains a candidate; no owner adoption is recorded.
The development profile and generated system ontology are not admitted.
The exact Rust baseline has not been independently accepted and its conformance remains not_evaluable.
No router or execution adapter invokes this candidate; ontology enforcement remains suspended.
